At ReelWolves Casino, there is more to explore than simply choosing a slot. Moon Wheels brings three different prize wheels together, allowing players to choose a qualifying deposit amount and compete for a corresponding selection of rewards. Only one wheel can be activated per day: Eclipse Wheel, Half Moon Wheel or Full Moon Wheel. Your choice determines both the maximum potential prize and the conditions attached to any reward you receive.

Another distinctive feature of ReelWolves is its ten-tier loyalty programme, which awards points for real-money wagers and offers cashback of up to 20%. Alongside these benefits, players can explore slots, live dealer games and separate offers for their first deposits. Bonus requirements vary between promotions, however, so understanding the wagering conditions and applicable restrictions is essential before activating an offer.

Moon Wheels

Three Moon Wheel options are available at ReelWolves Casino, each with its own minimum deposit, prize selection and wagering requirements. The process is straightforward: make a qualifying deposit, enter the relevant promotional code before completing the payment and unlock a wheel spin. Each player can participate once per day. Even when a deposit is large enough to qualify for multiple wheels, only one of the three options may be selected.

Wheel Minimum Deposit Maximum Cash Prize Bonus Code
Eclipse Wheel £50 £2,000 ECLIPSE_WHEEL
Half Moon Wheel £100 £4,000 HALFMOON_WHEEL
Full Moon Wheel £250 £10,000 FULLMOON_WHEEL

Eclipse Wheel has the lowest entry requirement. Possible rewards include 10, 20, 50 or 100 Free Spins worth £0.10 each, alongside cash bonuses of £10, £20, £50 or £2,000. The Free Spins are awarded on selected BGaming titles, including Gold Rush with Johnny Cash and Wild Cash x9990. Both cash bonuses and winnings generated from Free Spins carry a x10 wagering requirement. The advertised prize amount should therefore not be treated as money that can immediately be withdrawn.

Half Moon Wheel introduces Super Spins valued at £1 per spin. Available rewards include 20 or 50 standard Free Spins worth £0.10 each, 5 or 15 Super Spins, and cash bonuses ranging from £10 to £4,000. The main difference from Eclipse Wheel lies in the conditions for cash rewards, which carry a x1 wagering requirement without a maximum cashout cap on bonus winnings. Winnings from Free Spins awarded on Wild Cash by BGaming remain subject to x10 wagering.

Full Moon Wheel offers 10, 15, 20 or 30 Super Spins worth £1 each, together with cash bonuses of £50, £100, £250 or £10,000. Cash prizes also carry x1 wagering without a maximum cashout cap on bonus winnings, while Free Spin winnings require x10 wagering. The spins are allocated to selected BGaming games, including Multi Rush, Wild Cash and Gold Rush with Johnny Cash. A higher qualifying deposit provides access to a different prize pool but does not guarantee the maximum advertised reward.

Before taking part in Moon Wheels, players should consider the general bonus conditions. Only one bonus can normally remain active at a time, and promotional rewards have limited validity periods. ReelWolves applies a standard three-day period for completing wagering requirements unless a particular offer specifies otherwise. The wheel conditions also relate to the prizes awarded rather than providing any guarantee that the qualifying deposit will be returned.

VIP Program

The loyalty programme at ReelWolves Casino operates without a separate opt-in. CP points are earned automatically through real-money wagering. Slots award 1 CP for every £10, €10 or CHF 10 wagered, while roulette, card games, crash titles and other game categories require the equivalent of £50, €50 or CHF 50 in wagers for the same point. Progress is calculated from total eligible bets rather than deposits or winnings. Bets placed using bonus funds do not contribute.

The programme consists of ten ranks, starting with Pup at 20 CP and progressing to Legendary Wolf, which requires at least 2,000,000 CP. Each level brings a separate reward. Pup provides 20 Free Spins, while Scout awards 100 Free Spins. Cash bonuses begin at Tracker and increase at subsequent ranks. Legendary Wolf includes a rank reward of £50,000, €50,000 or CHF 50,000. This is a promotional bonus subject to its own conditions rather than a guaranteed cash payment.

VIP Level CP Required Cashback
Pup 20-119 5% daily
Scout 120-1,499 5% daily
Tracker 1,500-5,999 5% daily
Hunter, Pack Member, Pack Leader, Shadow Fang, Alpha Wolf 6,000-799,999 10% daily
Elder Alpha 800,000-1,999,999 15% weekly
Legendary Wolf 2,000,000+ 20% weekly

Cashback is calculated exclusively from slot activity. The casino subtracts total real-money winnings from total real-money wagers and applies the percentage associated with the player's rank. Pup and Scout require a minimum net loss of £20 or its equivalent, while higher ranks have a £10 threshold. Daily cashback for levels up to Alpha Wolf is scheduled for the following day between 13:00 and 14:00 UTC. Elder Alpha and Legendary Wolf receive weekly cashback, credited on Mondays during the same period. Players have one day to claim the reward.

Cashback at the first five ranks carries x10 wagering. This decreases to x1 for Pack Leader, Shadow Fang and Alpha Wolf, as well as the weekly rewards available at the two highest ranks. Rank-up bonuses follow separate conditions: Pack Leader has x10 wagering, while Shadow Fang through Legendary Wolf receive x1 wagering with no maximum bonus win cap. According to the VIP level structure, a personal VIP manager becomes available at Elder Alpha and Legendary Wolf. These differences make the terms attached to each rank just as relevant as the cashback percentage itself.

Games

The game catalogue at ReelWolves Casino covers online slots, table games, crash games and dedicated selections of new and popular titles. Featured developers include BGaming, Belatra, AvatarUX, Booongo, Betsoft, NetGame, Endorphina, InOut, Gamzix, 1spin4win, Popiplay and MrSlotty. The selection combines familiar casino formats with more recent game mechanics, giving players alternatives to traditional slot machines and standard table games.

Slot games at ReelWolves explore a variety of themes and visual styles. Aloha King Elvis takes inspiration from music, while Big Wild Buffalo 2 and Big Wild Buffalo feature wildlife imagery. Fruit-themed titles include Cherry Pop and Magic Apple 2, while Grab More Gold and Make It Gold introduce adventure-inspired settings. This range allows players to explore games according to their preferred themes rather than remaining with one studio or a single type of slot.

The mechanics of an individual slot deserve attention before placing a wager. A game's name, artwork or position in a popular selection does not automatically reveal how frequently bonus rounds occur, its volatility or its return-to-player percentage. Titles such as Hippo Pop, Looneypop, Big Bang and Cyber Gypsies add variety to the catalogue, but their individual characteristics should be checked through the information menu within each game. Betting ranges, available features and outcomes depend on the rules of the selected title rather than its catalogue category.

The distinction between slots, table games and crash games also matters when a bonus is active. Under the standard bonus contribution rules, slot wagers contribute 100% towards wagering requirements, while live casino and table games contribute 10%. Other game categories contribute 0%, unless a particular promotion states otherwise. Switching between game types during bonus play can therefore affect how quickly the wagering requirements are completed.

Live Games

The live games section at ReelWolves Casino includes dealer-hosted tables and several versions of roulette. Available examples include Golden Hall Baccarat by Vivo Gaming, Live Roulette by Live Vegas, Infinite Casino Hold'em by Vivo Gaming and Blackjack B by Live Vegas. Unlike conventional slots, these games follow established card and table game rules, with selected tables featuring interaction with a dealer through a live video stream.

Roulette is particularly well represented, with options such as Auto Roulette Retro and its different table versions, Las Vegas Roulette, American Roulette, Mahogany Auto Roulette and several Absolute Roulette variations, including Absolute Black, Bright, Brown and RNG. Some games use an automated wheel rather than a dealer appearing on screen, so the format should be checked when opening a table. American Roulette also differs from other versions in its wheel configuration, which affects the probabilities associated with individual bets.

Card game enthusiasts can find several blackjack and baccarat tables at ReelWolves, including Las Vegas Blackjack, Limitless Blackjack, Marina Bay Baccarat and Miami Beach Baccarat. Imperial Dragon Tiger provides another card-based format with rules that differ from conventional blackjack. Before joining a table, it is worth checking the minimum betting amount, decision rules and any optional side bets. Game availability may vary by region and the time at which a particular table is accessed.

Promotions

Beyond Moon Wheels, ReelWolves Casino offers a sequence of bonuses across the first three deposits. A qualifying first deposit of at least £20 provides a 100% match bonus up to £1,000 and 200 Free Spins. The promotional code is HALLO1_WOLF. Free Spins are distributed in four batches of 50: the first is credited after the eligible deposit, followed by another batch every 24 hours. These spins are available on selected BGaming slots. Cancelling the bonus also cancels any remaining Free Spins that have not yet been credited.

The second deposit offer becomes available after claiming the first bonus. It provides a 50% match up to £2,500 on deposits of at least £20 using HALLO2_WOLF. The third offer follows the second and provides a 150% bonus up to £1,500, again requiring a minimum deposit of £20, with HALLO3_WOLF as the promotional code. These are sequential offers rather than three independent promotions that can be activated in any order. Eligibility depends on the deposit sequence and the previous bonus being claimed.

New players making their first cryptocurrency deposit can choose a separate 300% bonus up to £100 with the code CRYPTO_WOLF. A minimum deposit equivalent to £20 is required, together with a cryptocurrency wallet for the selected currency. This promotion carries a x10 wagering requirement. Welcome offers at ReelWolves are alternatives rather than cumulative rewards, meaning players must choose the appropriate package instead of expecting to receive several welcome bonuses simultaneously.

The general bonus conditions at ReelWolves Casino specify x10 wagering unless an individual promotion provides a different requirement. Wagering normally needs to be completed within three days, while Free Spins must be claimed within one day. Standard maximum winnings are £300 for Free Spin rewards and £5,000 for bonus winnings, or the equivalent in the account currency. During wagering, the usual maximum bet is £5. Requesting a withdrawal before the conditions have been fulfilled cancels the bonus and its associated winnings. Rewards carrying x1 wagering have separate betting rules and applicable restrictions.

Another promotional feature at ReelWolves is the Product Store, where players can purchase Free Spin packages, bonus money and Mystery Boxes. For example, a €2 package provides 20 spins worth €0.20 each on eligible slots, while higher-priced packages offer different spin values. Bonus money packages include €25 in bonus funds for €15, €100 for €50 and €250 for €100. Five types of Mystery Boxes contain randomly allocated prizes, including Free Spins and cash bonuses, with a maximum advertised cash prize of €50,000. Cash bonuses awarded through these boxes carry x1 wagering, alongside the applicable general bonus conditions.

Responsible Gaming

Real-money gaming at ReelWolves Casino should remain a form of entertainment, making it essential to manage both playing time and spending. Once a planned budget has been exhausted, continuing to play in an attempt to recover losses can create further financial difficulties. Cashback and bonuses should not be treated as a way to offset losses, since these rewards have conditions and do not eliminate the risks associated with gambling. Setting a clear entertainment budget in advance and keeping money needed for everyday expenses separate from gambling funds can help maintain control.

Players who need to restrict their gambling activity can request self-exclusion at ReelWolves through customer support via live chat. Anyone experiencing difficulty controlling their spending or the frequency of their gaming sessions may ask to be excluded from further play. Support can also be contacted when concerns arise about the gambling behaviour of a friend or family member. The casino's conditions additionally state that deposit limits cannot be applied to cryptocurrency payments made through the CPP system, so players wishing to use deposit limits should consider an alternative payment method.

Participation in real-money gambling at ReelWolves Casino is restricted to people who have reached the legal gambling age in their jurisdiction. Access is also prohibited for residents of certain territories, including Ukraine, where deposits and real-money play are not permitted under the casino's terms. Using a VPN to circumvent geographical restrictions is prohibited. If gambling stops being enjoyable or becomes difficult to control, the appropriate response is to stop playing and seek specialist assistance.

Mobile App

Players can enjoy ReelWolves Casino on a smartphone as well as on a computer. Mobile access makes it possible to open slot games, explore live dealer tables and manage an existing account without relying on a desktop device. A stable internet connection is particularly useful for games involving live video streams, where interruptions can affect the playing experience.

In addition to playing through a mobile browser, users can download the ReelWolves app to their phone. Once installed, they can sign in to their existing account and select their preferred game category. Checking compatibility with the device before installation helps ensure that the application can be used as intended.

mainEntity.name: Can I activate two different Moon Wheels on the same day?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Players are limited to one spin on one of the three available wheels per day, even if their deposit would qualify them for a more expensive option.

The main account currencies are GBP, EUR and CHF. The deposit conditions also include selected cryptocurrencies and stablecoins, such as BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC. The availability of individual payment methods depends on the player's region.

mainEntity.name: What requirements apply before withdrawing funds?

acceptedAnswer.text: The standard minimum withdrawal is £50, €50 or CHF 50. Deposits must be wagered at least three times before a withdrawal can be requested, and identity or payment method verification may be required. Standard withdrawal limits are £4,000 per day, £8,000 per week and £30,000 per month, or the equivalent in another supported currency. Requests are processed according to the applicable verification procedures and payment provider requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can I have more than one account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Each player is permitted to maintain only one account. Creating additional accounts or sharing an account with another person may result in restrictions, account closure or forfeiture of funds under the casino's terms.

mainEntity.name: What happens if my account remains inactive?

acceptedAnswer.text: An account may be classified as dormant after 90 days without activity. Under the casino's terms, the operator reserves the right to close dormant accounts and retain any remaining balance. Reactivation may be requested through customer support.

FAQ.answer: The main account currencies are GBP, EUR and CHF. The deposit conditions also include selected cryptocurrencies and stablecoins, such as BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC. The availability of individual payment methods depends on the player's region.
FAQ.question: Which currencies are accepted?

FAQ.answer: The standard minimum withdrawal is £50, €50 or CHF 50. Deposits must be wagered at least three times before a withdrawal can be requested, and identity or payment method verification may be required. Standard withdrawal limits are £4,000 per day, £8,000 per week and £30,000 per month, or the equivalent in another supported currency. Requests are processed according to the applicable verification procedures and payment provider requirements.
FAQ.question: What requirements apply before withdrawing funds?

FAQ.question: Can I have more than one account?
